description: Instructor area: API of plan section 3.4 (schedule, roster, attendance with +1 hours exactly once, End class, class/student/grading remarks, students, profile + anonymous feedback summary, examiner-only grading window, candidate results) and rewiring of instructor_portal pages. Depends on FEAT-001 (and reuses models from FEAT-002). Independent of FEAT-004/005.
steps: Read plan.md D18, D19, D22 and sections 3.4, 5 (instructor), then instructor_portal/instructor.js (schedule, roster, endClassFlow, remarks, EXAM_* rubric lines ~376-520, renderProfile), instructor_portal/*.html and the examinerShift()/GATED code in portal.js.

Models: instructorModel, sessionModel additions (instructor schedule by date range, session by id with owner check), attendanceModel (mark/transition with row lock), remarkModel (upsert by kind/lesson/student/instructor), gradingModel additions (examiner panels, window state, candidates, result write, grading_history insert, student_profile last_grading_date), feedbackModel (aggregates only).

Services: attendanceService.mark(tx, {lessonId, userId, status, actor}) per D19 (idempotent; +duration hours on total/accumulated, +weapon on Weapons; blocked before open window, after End class; shared later with admin roster) and endClass(); gradingRules.js copied from instructor.js (EXAM_BANDS, rubric criteria keys, EXAM_MAX, thresholds 70%/50%) with result computed on the server; gradingService.submitResult (examiner membership, window start-15min..end, one result per candidate, Pass -> promotion_status 'Pending approval' + grading_history, Retake/Fail -> grade false and 'n/a', session status In progress/Completed). Grading never touches class_session and venue stays hq.

Controllers/routes/validators: src/routes/instructor.routes.js with requireRole('instructor'); every :lessonId route checks class_session.instructor_id = req.user.id (403 NOT_YOUR_CLASS), every grading route checks grading_examiner (403 NOT_EXAMINER). Implement all endpoints in plan 3.4.

Front end: add src/public/instructor_portal/instructor-data.js (load.schedule/roster/students/profile/grading, act.mark/end/remark/gradingNote/submitResult) and add it to the three instructor pages' data-then lists. Convert instructor.js: replace MY_INS with ASK.me.name, SCHED_ALL/CLASSES schedule with API sessions keyed by lessonId, classState from server clock (NOW()), roster/attendance ticks via act.mark, End class via act.end, remove simulateTaps/inst.sim/DB.classEnded/save(), remarks via act.remark/act.gradingNote, grading page via load.grading + act.submitResult, remove the demoOn checkbox and DB.panels[0].demoOn. portal.js examiner gating uses the loaded panel window. Keep the stand-in photo helper.

Write verification: .be-tmp/verify/api-instructor.mjs (Bob sees only his own sessions; Steven/Robin cannot read Bob's roster (403); marking Attended twice credits hours once (check student_profile hours before/after); No-Show credits nothing; later class returns 409 CLASS_NOT_OPEN for attendance and remarks; End class marks leftover Booked as No-Show and blocks further changes; grading: fixture grading_session inserted for today around the server time with Bob as examiner and two candidates: outside the window 409 GRADING_NOT_OPEN, non-examiner 403, result submission within the window computes Pass/Retake/Fail from scores, Pass leaves promotion 'Pending approval' and rank unchanged until FEAT-005; feedback summary has no student identity) and .be-tmp/verify/browser-instructor.mjs (sign in INS-0042, load index/grading/profile at 1280/390 with zero errors, grading page gated until the fixture window, mark attendance, end class, submit one candidate result, assert Bob's schedule rows equal seed class_session rows for the fake day, screenshot index and profile).
acceptance_criteria: Instructor endpoints enforce ownership and examiner window rules and return 401/403/409 with the documented codes.
Marking present adds exactly one session of hours once (no double count), proven by SQL before/after in the API suite.
Instructor pages load from the API with zero console errors at 1280 and 390 px and use no storage for data.
The grading page is only reachable for an examiner inside the 15-minutes-before..end window.
verification: node .be-tmp/verify/browser-instructor.mjs: pages + flows pass, zero console errors
findings:
VERIFIED (all run): api-instructor 98/98, browser-instructor 60/60 (zero console errors, 1280+390, grading gated until the fixture window, tick/end class/remarks/result through the real pages), regression api-auth 68/68, api-student 118/118, api-public 40/40, api-sqli 92/92, browser-login 162/162, browser-student 67/67, npm test -- --runInBand exit 0. Nothing committed/staged. NOTE: I once wrote src/services/instructorService.js through a PowerShell string Replace + WriteAllText (new file of mine, content only import tweaks); all other edits used the edit tools.
NEW BACKEND: models/instructorModel.js; additions in sessionModel (listForInstructor, getForInstructor(lessonId, db, lock), markEnded), attendanceModel (roster, lockRow, setStatus, counts, listBookedIds, onRoster), studentModel (addHours(userId,hours,weaponBool,db), hoursOf, setLastGradingDate), remarkModel (findMine, insert, update, remove, classRemark, gradingNotesFor), feedbackModel (summaryFor, tagCounts, recentFor, countSince), gradingModel (panelsFor, panelOf(sessionId, instructorId, db, lock), candidatesOf, lockCandidate, scoreCandidate, insertHistory, setSessionStatus), closureModel.overlapping. Services: attendanceService, instructorService, gradingService additions; validators/instructor.js, controllers/instructorController.js, routes/instructor.routes.js (mounted at /instructor in routes/index.js).
SIGNATURES FOR LATER FEATS: attendanceService.mark(tx, {lessonId, userId, status:'Attended'|'No-Show'|'Booked', actor:{role,id}, reason=null, lesson=null}) -> {status, changed, hours, credited}. Run inside withTx. actor.role 'instructor' => ownership (403 NOT_YOUR_CLASS), clock window (409 CLASS_NOT_OPEN before start-30min, 409 CLASS_ENDED once ended_at set or now >= end time) and marked_by = actor.id. Any other role (use {role:'admin', id}) skips ownership and window checks (desk correction), marked_by stays NULL, `reason` is saved in class_attendance.remarks; a cancelled session is still refused (409 CLASS_CANCELLED). Hours: credited once on the transition into Attended = lesson length in hours (end-start, one decimal) to total_accumulated_hours and accumulated_hours (+weapon_hours when class_type='Weapons'); guests (no student_profile) credit nothing; Attended -> anything else is 409 ALREADY_COUNTED; same status again is a no-op (changed:false). attendanceService.endClass(tx, {lessonId, actor, present:[ids], noShow:[ids]}) -> {present, noShow, endedAt}: marks lists, leftover Booked -> No-Show, class_session.status 'Ended' + ended_at. Also exports stateOf(session, now) ('later'|'open'|'live'|'done'), lessonHours, ownLesson(tx, lessonId, actor, lock), OPEN_LEAD_MIN. FEAT-004 admin roster can call mark/endClass with actor {role:'admin', id}.
GRADING HELPERS: gradingRules additions EXAM_BANDS, EXAM_CRITERIA_KEYS ('Omote-entry' ... 'Ura-posture', 6 keys scored 0-3), EXAM_MAX 18, EXAM_PASS_PCT .7, EXAM_RETAKE_PCT .5, examTotal(scores), examResult(total) -> Pass|Retake|Fail, examPercent(total). gradingService additions: windowOf(panelRow, now) -> {opensAt,start,end,state:'locked'|'soon'|'live'|'over',open}, panelShape, myPanels(user), candidates(user, sessionId), submitResult(user, sessionId, userId, {scores,well,toImprove}) -> {result,score,marks,max,promotion,left}, examinerPanel(user, sessionId, db, lock). Window = start-15min..end of the panel; session status becomes 'In progress' after the first result and 'Completed' when none is Pending; Pass -> promotion_status 'Pending approval' (rank untouched; FEAT-005 does promote/decline), grading_history row (GH-nn, grade=true only for Pass), student_profile.last_grading_date = session date. Retake is stored as grade false.
ENDPOINTS (/api/v1/instructor, requireRole instructor): GET profile {id,name,dan,photo,chief,stats{classesPerWeek,students,fillPct},feedback{count,avg,lastSevenDays,distribution{5..1},tags[{tag,count}],recent[{rating,tags,note,date,type}]}}; GET schedule?from&to (max 62 days, 400 RANGE_TOO_LONG/INVALID_RANGE) {sessions[{lessonId,date,time,end,mat,type,dojoId,dojoName,booked,cap,private,studentName,ended,endedAt,state}], grading[{id,label,date,from,to,venue,lead,examiners,status,candidateCount,left,state,locked,window}], closures[]}; GET students; GET sessions/:lessonId {session,state,rows[{userId,name,memberNo,rank,rankId,photo(null),sessions,need,seen,status,how,goingForGrading,remark,gradingNote,earlier[]}],classRemark}; PUT sessions/:lessonId/attendance/:userId {status} -> {status,changed,hours,totalHours}; POST sessions/:lessonId/end {present,noShow}; PUT sessions/:lessonId/remarks {kind:'class'|'student',studentId?,body} (empty body deletes -> {deleted:true}; 409 CLASS_NOT_OPEN before start-30min, allowed after end); PUT students/:userId/grading-note {lessonId?,body} (403 NOT_YOUR_STUDENT, 409 NOT_GOING_FOR_GRADING); GET grading {panels[{session,window,counts,candidates? only when window open}]}; GET grading/sessions/:id/candidates (403 NOT_EXAMINER, 409 GRADING_NOT_OPEN); POST grading/sessions/:id/candidates/:userId/result {scores{6 keys 0-3},well,toImprove,signature:true|string} (404 NOT_CANDIDATE, 409 ALREADY_SCORED). Other codes: LESSON_NOT_FOUND 404, NOT_ON_CLASS 404, CLASS_CANCELLED 409, STUDENT_REQUIRED 400. Decisions: attendance time-over-but-not-ended classes are locked for instructors (409 CLASS_ENDED), ticks cannot be undone (UI locks a ticked row), instructors are not allowed to end/mark a class after its end time.
FRONT END: new instructor_portal/instructor-data.js (SCHED, ASK.load.schedule/roster/students/profile/grading, ASK.act.mark/end/remark/gradingNote/submitResult); data-then of the 3 instructor pages is now store.js,instructor-data.js,portal.js,instructor.js. instructor.js fully rewritten (no save/classEnded/simulateTaps/demo toggle; lessonId keys; schedule range loaded per view; grading page via load.grading + submitResult; profile from ASK.insProfile). api.js boot now preloads ASK.panels (GET /instructor/grading) for instructors; portal.js examinerShift() reads ASK.panels (window opensAt..end with NOW()), bell uses shift.left and ASK.insProfile.feedback.lastSevenDays. profile.html demo switch and grading.html static date removed (id examSub). data.js SEED panels lost demoOn. recordMyAttendance and save() stubs remain in store.js (still used by student mock scanner and admin-desk.js: FEAT-004). Student photos are not stored: the stand-in photo helper is kept. Per-criterion scores of a sent result are not stored (only the percentage), so a reloaded sent result shows the result and marks, not the bands.
HARNESS: .be-tmp/verify/api-instructor.mjs, browser-instructor.mjs, instructor-fixtures.mjs (lessons around the current SG time on the fake day 2026-11-06; live parts skip themselves if the server clock is within 00:20..22:00 SG excluded), peek.mjs. db.mjs was stopped and .dbport removed.
